about_the_game:
Get ready to NOK it out of the park with this physics-based sandbox hidden object game! Step into a virtual world where you'll toss your worries aside and dive headfirst into the wild art of furniture flinging. It's like a treasure hunt, but with a twist! Explore meticulously designed environments that will leave you chair-ished and table-lled with excitement. Sharpen those observation skills, because in NOK, you'll need to think outside the box to uncover hidden treasures and unravel pun-tastic secrets. This game merges the joy of exploration with puzzle-solving, offering hours of relaxing gameplay. Get ready to NOK 'n' roll in this Demo and explore a selection of our themes and levels!

Features

  • Fun Physics - Everyone feels the frustration of not finding what they're looking for. Make a mess up until you find it! The vast majority of items can be grabbed and thrown. Let your inner messiness come to the surface to find the hidden objects in this chaotic environment!

  • Dad Jokes - Nothing is as it seems. You're trying to find a master door controller? Or a Portable Air Bubble? Find out what these names could describe to be able to know what you're looking for. Sometimes, all it takes is a little hint leading you into the right direction.

  • Hidden Secrets - The more you explore, the more you find! Unknown interactions and secret items are waiting to be revealed... Grill the perfect marshmallow by combining items or build the biggest lego castle, and maybe there's even a friendly snail lurking around? Everything is just a click away.

  • Collect Trophies - Finish a theme to unlock a trophy room in NOK's museum. Entering this trophy room will make it easy for you to get to know which items you have and haven't found yet. Every found item will be stored in the trophy room - find them all to finish your precious collection!

  • Minigames - Need a break from looking for your long lost sock? Browse through our collection of minigames which all make use of NOK's signature mechanic: NOK'ing things around! Flip a bottle on first try or destroy all clay pots in the rage room to let go of frustration - NOK has got you covered!

  • Relaxation - There's no rush. You have all the time in the world to explore your favorite scenarios and discover their secrets. So, just sit back, relax, and listen to the ambiance. Everything in due time.

Sometimes all we want is to unleash chaos and disorder (and you can do that here).
